verdict.rationale: mise documents a first-party lockfile workflow: commit a lockfile and run `mise install --locked` for reproducible CI installs where every job gets the same versions. It also documents a `mise lock` command for managing the lockfile. The pack never states that `--locked` fails the install when mise.toml and the lockfile disagree, so the enforcement half of the story is implied by the flag name rather than evidenced. missing for 10: explicit documentation that `--locked` errors on manifest/lockfile mismatch (exit behavior, what counts as drift), lockfile format/scope details, independent or hands-on corroboration of frozen-mode failures.
